item.title: Rare 96-Place Childcare Centre Offered for Lease in Melbourne’s Blue Chip Bayside
item.description: A fully renovated 96-place childcare centre in the heart of Melbourne’s blue chip Bayside is being offered for lease, presenting operators with a rare opportunity to secure an established childcare facility without the lengthy development and construction lead times typically associated with new centres.
